<!--
Element: Rotating-example AI prompt box
ID: 233 · Category: Hero & Backgrounds · Tags: ai, prompt, hero, placeholder, input
What it does: In the big input box on an AI product's first screen, example prompts type themselves out, erase and change, while a glowing border slowly circles it. Press a suggestion chip below to type that prompt into the box, then press send and the arrow turns into a spinner as a generating card unfolds below with shimmering lines.
How to use it: Press a suggestion chip to fill the box, then press send
Footprint: fixed size, square
Needs: tokens.css (the --ux-* theme tokens and the .ux base). Map the tokens to the project's theme variables.
Live demo: https://lucianlabs.dev/uxui-prompt/#233
-->
<style>
.u233{position:relative;width:340px;height:340px;border-radius:30px;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(90% 60% at 50% 0%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--ux-accent) 16%,transparent),transparent 70%),var(--ux-surface);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--ux-line),0 30px 60px -36px var(--ux-shadow-strong);color:var(--ux-ink)}

.u233-g{position:absolute;inset:0;transform:translateY(46px);transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.3,1,.3,1)}
.u233.is-run .u233-g,.u233.is-done .u233-g{transform:none}
.u233-h{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:30px;margin:0;text-align:center;font-size:22px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.u233-s{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:62px;text-align:center;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:650;color:var(--ux-ink-3)}
.u233-bx{position:absolute;left:18px;right:18px;top:92px;height:92px;border-radius:20px;padding:1.5px;background:conic-gradient(from var(--u233-a,0deg),var(--ux-accent),#22D3EE,#F472B6,var(--ux-accent));animation:u233-spin 6s linear infinite}
@property --u233-a{syntax:'<angle>';inherits:false;initial-value:0deg}
@keyframes u233-spin{to{--u233-a:360deg}}
.u233-in{position:relative;height:100%;border-radius:18.5px;background:var(--ux-surface);padding:12px 14px}
.u233-tx{display:block;width:100%;height:46px;border:0;padding:0;background:none;resize:none;font:inherit;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;font-weight:650;color:var(--ux-ink);outline:none}
.u233-ph{position:absolute;left:14px;top:12px;right:56px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;font-weight:600;color:var(--ux-ink-3);pointer-events:none}
.u233-ph::after{content:"";display:inline-block;width:1.5px;height:1.05em;margin-left:1px;vertical-align:-2px;background:var(--ux-accent);animation:u233-cur 1s steps(2) infinite}
@keyframes u233-cur{50%{opacity:0}}
.u233-go{position:absolute;right:10px;bottom:10px;width:32px;height:32px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ux-ink);color:var(--ux-surface);display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s,background .2s}
.u233-go:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:default}
.u233-go svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.u233-go .u233-sp{display:none;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid currentColor;border-right-color:transparent;animation:u233-rot .7s linear infinite}
.u233.is-run .u233-go svg{display:none}
.u233.is-run .u233-go .u233-sp{display:block}
@keyframes u233-rot{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.u233-go:focus-visible,.u233-ch:focus-visible,.u233-nw:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ux-accent);outline-offset:2px}
.u233-chs{position:absolute;left:18px;right:18px;top:194px;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:6px;transition:opacity .3s,transform .3s}
.u233-ch{border:0;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--ux-surface-2);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ux-line);color:var(--ux-ink-2);font:inherit;font-size:11px;font-weight:750;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
.u233-ch:hover{background:var(--ux-accent-soft);color:var(--ux-ink)}
.u233.is-run .u233-chs,.u233.is-done .u233-chs{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);pointer-events:none}
.u233-gen{position:absolute;left:18px;right:18px;top:196px;height:124px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--ux-surface-2);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ux-line);padding:12px 14px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px) scale(.97);transition:opacity .35s,transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.1);pointer-events:none}
.u233.is-run .u233-gen{transition-delay:.18s}
.u233.is-run .u233-gen,.u233.is-done .u233-gen{opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}
.u233-gh{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:11px;font-weight:850}
.u233-gh i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ux-accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 0 var(--ux-accent);animation:u233-pl 1.2s ease-out infinite}
.u233.is-done .u233-gh i{background:var(--ux-mint);animation:none}
@keyframes u233-pl{70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px transparent}}
.u233-gs{font-size:10px;font-weight:650;color:var(--ux-ink-3);margin:3px 0 10px}
.u233-ln{height:9px;border-radius:5px;margin-top:7px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ux-line) 0 30%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--ux-accent) 40%,var(--ux-surface)) 50%,var(--ux-line) 70%);background-size:300% 100%;animation:u233-sh 1.4s linear infinite;transform-origin:0 50%;transition:transform .5s}
@keyframes u233-sh{from{background-position:100% 0}to{background-position:-100% 0}}
.u233.is-done .u233-ln{animation:none;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ux-accent) 22%,var(--ux-surface))}
.u233-nw{position:absolute;right:12px;bottom:10px;border:0;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--ux-ink);color:var(--ux-surface);font:inherit;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s}
.u233.is-done .u233-nw{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.u233-bx,.u233-ln,.u233-ph::after{animation:none}.u233-g,.u233-gen{transition:none}}

<div class="ux u233">
  <div class="u233-g">
  <h3 class="u233-h">What should we build?</h3>
  <div class="u233-s">Describe it and it becomes a screen</div>
  <div class="u233-bx"><div class="u233-in"><textarea class="u233-tx" rows="2" aria-label="Describe the screen you want"></textarea><span class="u233-ph" aria-hidden="true"></span><button type="button" class="u233-go" aria-label="Send" disabled><svg viewBox="0 0 14 14" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 12V2M2.5 6.5 7 2l4.5 4.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg><span class="u233-sp"></span></button></div></div>
  <div class="u233-chs" role="group" aria-label="Suggested prompts"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="u233-gen" aria-live="polite"><div class="u233-gh"><i aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="u233-gt"></span></div><div class="u233-gs"></div><div class="u233-ln" style="width:92%"></div><div class="u233-ln" style="width:74%"></div><div class="u233-ln" style="width:84%"></div><button type="button" class="u233-nw">New prompt</button></div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  var root = document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;
  var tx = root.querySelector('.u233-tx'), ph = root.querySelector('.u233-ph'), go = root.querySelector('.u233-go'), chs = root.querySelector('.u233-chs'), gt = root.querySelector('.u233-gt'), gs = root.querySelector('.u233-gs'), nw = root.querySelector('.u233-nw');
  var rm = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var EX = ['Build a landing page for café bookings', 'Switch my to-do app to dark mode', 'Add a project gallery to my portfolio'];
  var CHIPS = ['Landing page', 'Pricing table', 'Sign-in screen'];
  var FILL = ['Make a startup landing page, starting with the hero', 'Make a pricing table with three plans', 'Make a sign-in screen with social login'];
  var ex = 0, pos = 0, dir = 1, phT = 0, typeT = 0, runT = 0;
  function phTick() {
    clearTimeout(phT);
    if (!root.isConnected) return;
    if (tx.value || root.classList.contains('is-run')) { ph.textContent = ''; return; }
    var s = Array.from(EX[ex]);
    if (rm) { ph.textContent = EX[ex]; ex = (ex + 1) % EX.length; phT = setTimeout(phTick, 2600); return; }
    pos += dir; ph.textContent = s.slice(0, pos).join('');
    var wait = 55;
    if (dir > 0 && pos >= s.length) { dir = -1; wait = 1500; }
    else if (dir < 0 && pos <= 0) { dir = 1; ex = (ex + 1) % EX.length; wait = 350; }
    else if (dir < 0) wait = 22;
    phT = setTimeout(phTick, wait);
  }
  function sync() { go.disabled = !tx.value.trim() || root.classList.contains('is-run'); if (!tx.value) { pos = 0; dir = 1; phTick(); } else { clearTimeout(phT); ph.textContent = ''; } }
  CHIPS.forEach(function (c, i) {
    var b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'u233-ch'; b.textContent = c;
    b.addEventListener('click', function () {
      clearTimeout(typeT); clearTimeout(phT); ph.textContent = '';
      var s = Array.from(FILL[i]), k = 0;
      if (rm) { tx.value = FILL[i]; sync(); return; }
      tx.value = '';
      (function t() { tx.value = s.slice(0, ++k).join(''); go.disabled = false; if (k < s.length) typeT = setTimeout(t, 28); else sync(); })();
    });
    chs.appendChild(b);
  });
  go.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (go.disabled) return;
    root.classList.remove('is-done'); root.classList.add('is-run'); go.disabled = true;
    gt.textContent = 'Building'; gs.textContent = 'Laying out the screen…';
    clearTimeout(runT); runT = setTimeout(function () { root.classList.remove('is-run'); root.classList.add('is-done'); gt.textContent = 'Done! Open preview'; gs.textContent = tx.value; }, rm ? 300 : 2400);
  });
  nw.addEventListener('click', function () { root.classList.remove('is-done', 'is-run'); tx.value = ''; sync(); tx.focus({ preventScroll: true }); });
  tx.addEventListener('input', sync);
  tx.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); go.click(); } });
  phTick();
})();
</script>
